unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 10 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.2 - THEME 6: LIFE IN THE WORLD & CULTURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will implement a questionnaire about celebrities and influencers who contribute to the community positively. First, they will prepare at least ten survey questions about the topic. Then, they will ask these questions to their friends in their classes. They may conduct the questionnaire online as well. After conducting, they will categorise the results and find the most popular celebrity, the least successful one, etc. according to their contributions to the community and present them in the class. They may use graphs, charts or visuals in their presentations. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the world and culture with its components such as media, popular culture, celebrities and influencers; global influence of films, music, and fashion on culture and lifestyles; cross-cultural communication'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school may know what media, popular culture, celebrities and influencers; global influence of films, music, and fashion on culture and lifestyles; cross-cultural communication mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in the world and culture'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the world and culture with its components such as media, popular culture, celebrities and influencers; global influence of films, music, and fashion on culture and lifestyles; cross-cultural communication'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss about the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about opinions on media and popular culture in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Design Your Global Culture Awards Students watch a short and animated video about a ''Celebrity Awards Night for best contributors to the world (for the environment, research, etc.)''. The video focuses on the target vocabulary, such as ''fame'', ''contribution'', ''broadcast'', and ''premiere'', along with target grammar examples, such as ''By the end of the ceremony, new targets to help people will have been introduced''. After the video, students work in groups to design their own ''Global Culture Awards'' or ''Global Contribution Awards'' by using a Web 2 tool. Each project must include: Event Description: Students use the target vocabulary to describe the event, e.g. ''The event will provide widespread cultural contributions''. Schedule: Students create a timeline by using the target grammar, e.g. ''Cultural performances will be staged throughout the evening''. Tagline: Students add a creative tagline with a complex question tag, e.g. ''This will be an unforgettable night, won’t it?''. The activity ends with group presentations, where students share their designs, and the teacher gives feedback on the use of vocabulary, grammar, and creativity. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about media and popular culture in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Star Quest - Celebrity Awards Adventure Students watch a short and animated video introducing a ''Celebrity Awards Night for positive contributions to the world'', where vocabulary such as ''fame'', ''charity'', ''contribution'', ''broadcast'', and ''premiere'' is contextualised with target grammar examples such as ''Reporters will be talking to the stars on the red carpet''. They then participate in an interactive digital quiz using a Web 2.0 tool where instant feedback is provided. Questions include vocabulary matching (e.g. ''fame'' - popularity) and True/False activity. (''A broadcaster is a person who hosts events on the red carpet'' - False). As students go on, the teacher encourages them with phrases like ''Great effort!'' or ''You’re doing amazing!'' and highlights examples of strong performance to motivate others. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
